_what: Monthly median per STATION per variable. The unit is a position, not a water body, so any partition can be laid over it and judged instead of assumed.
_layout: For each variable in order: n uint16 station indices, then n uint16 month indices, then n float32 values, at the stated byte offset in stations_series.bin.
_not_here: Which water body each station falls in is deliberately absent. That is a model assumption, not a property of the measurement, and it lives in station_waterbody_overlay.json.
